discretion.description: The appeal challenged the DRB's refusal to accept the application without an Act 250 permit (a completeness question under the bylaws) and sought deemed approval under the 60-day rule of section 235(f); both turn on bylaw interpretation and dates, not evaluative standards.

observed_status.description: The court held the Act 250 permit was not a completeness prerequisite but denied deemed approval of the May 2004 application, and concluded this docket; the project's merits continued in a separate docket.
